first_current_hidden_interpretation: O_E was already ALWAYS_TRACED at n=1; it becomes current-hidden at n=2 only because the boundary has advanced outward.
infinite_family_proof: Every v with h(v)=s first belongs to INTERIOR_CAND at n=s+1 and is simultaneously on TRACE_CAND(s+1)=S_s. Hence no vertex can first enter the interior without having been traced by its own generation level.
robustness: For r>=1 the induced shell graph is C_(6r), so every primitive closed perimeter traversal has identical S_r vertex support. There are no SOMETIMES_TRACED shell vertices and the no-fresh-hidden theorem is independent of start point or orientation.
quantifier: NO candidate-arm interior vertex is NEVER_TRACED over its lifetime through the level at which it is present.
scope_warning: This is not yet a canonical theorem about CIRCLE_E(n), n>=2, because the frozen foundation has not selected a unique higher-circle perimeter/generation law.
